title: AlgoTrace: Algorithmic Primitives and Compositional Geometry of Reasoning in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.15987v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How do inference time and latent computations enable large language models (LLMs) to solve multi-step reasoning problems? We introduce AlgoTrace, a framework for tracing and steering algorithmic operations in the model latent space for multi-step reasoning. We operationalize primitives by clustering latent activations of the model when solving four benchmarks: Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP), 3SAT, AIME, and Graph Navigation. We annotate the clusters using their corresponding tokens in the reasoning trace. We then apply function vector methods to extract primitive vectors as reusable compositional building blocks of reasoning. We find that a) injecting a primitive vector into models (Phi, Qwen, Llama) elicits the associated algorithmic operation in the reasoning trace, b) injecting primitives can steer behavior across tasks, c) primitive vectors can be composed through algebraic operations, revealing a geometric logic in activati

translated_title: AlgoTrace：语言模型中推理的算法原语与组合几何
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.15987v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：推理时间和潜在计算如何使大型语言模型（LLMs）解决多步推理问题？我们引入了AlgoTrace，一个用于在多步推理中追踪和引导模型潜在空间中算法操作的框架。我们通过聚类模型在解决四个基准测试（旅行商问题（TSP）、3SAT、AIME和图导航）时的潜在激活来操作化原语。我们使用推理轨迹中的对应标记对聚类进行注释。然后，我们应用函数向量方法提取原语向量，作为推理的可重用组合构建块。我们发现：a) 将原语向量注入模型（Phi、Qwen、Llama）会在推理轨迹中引发相关的算法操作，b) 注入原语可以跨任务引导行为，c) 原语向量可以通过代数操作进行组合，揭示了激活中的几何逻辑。
tldr: 本文提出了AlgoTrace框架，通过聚类潜在激活提取算法原语向量，并证明这些向量可注入模型以引发和组合推理操作，从而揭示语言模型多步推理的几何逻辑。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AlgoTrace, a framework that extracts algorithmic primitive vectors via clustering latent activations, and demonstrates that injecting these vectors can elicit and compose reasoning operations, revealing the geometric logic of multi-step reasoning in language models.
